info.title: RSNA Knee S6 ConvNeXt all-data weights 0950
info.description:
# RSNA Knee: S6 ConvNeXt, all data, 0.950 public

One learned checkpoint, `E_prior_s42_fall.pt`: Heliosli's S6 architecture (convnext_small, per-finding spatial attention + window-attention MIL) retrained from the timm ImageNet-22k init on our report-derived JEV-blend soft labels, 4,263 competition studies, gold-58 excluded. Scored **0.950 public** alone in [rsna-knee-s6fall-solo](https://www.kaggle.com/code/nartaa/rsna-knee-s6fall-solo). Recipe and hashes: `checkpoint-manifest.json`. Write-up: the discussion post linked from the notebook.

The scored notebook, [rsna-knee-s6fall-solo](https://www.kaggle.com/code/nartaa/rsna-knee-s6fall-solo), runs from this dataset plus Heliosli's public [rsna-orthofoundation-fold0-epoch7-20261004](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/heliosli/rsna-orthofoundation-fold0-epoch7-20261004) (SKM-TEA anatomy V-Net and data pipeline, attached, not copied here) and our public 0.949 weights. `s6_extras.bin` holds the few code files his dataset lacks: his public-notebook `compact_*` scripts and 15 MONAI 0.6.0 files, both Apache-2.0. `code_manifest.json` pins the sha256 of every code file of the scored run.

No OAI data was used for this model. No images, reports or predictions are included.

## Training code

`training_code/` holds the exact S6 all-data trainer (`s6/train_s6f0_all.py`, sha256 ae18d2e1…) with its helpers, argv, pinned input manifest, frozen pool and targets; the JEV-blend soft labels with a script that rebuilds them; and the CoAtNet trainer and OAI wrapper behind our 0.949 / 0.945 weights. See `training_code/README.md`; every file is listed in `training_code/SHA256SUMS`. No OAI subject data is included. The code is shared under Apache-2.0 (competition public code-sharing rule); see `training_code/README.md`. Public scores do not establish clinical validity.
